title: Developing a Minimal Tripwire Suite for Scheming Detection

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tripwires are a low-cost, high-value monitoring primitive. A validated, public tripwire suite would be an immediately useful contribution insertable into any deployment pipeline.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing tripwire prompts and measuring behavioral differences across conditions is conceptually straightforward. Uses API calls, no fine-tuning needed. Sensitivity/specificity analysis is standard statistics.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Design 20-30 prompts, test across 3-5 models, measure sensitivity/specificity. Clear deliverable (a tripwire suite with performance metrics). Well-scoped for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
